configurations.name: nexbid-backend
runtimeArgs: Get-Content backend/.env -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*[A-Z_]+=.+' } | ForEach-Object { $k, $v = $_ -split '=', 2; Set-Item -Path ('env:' + $k.Trim()) -Value $v.Trim() }; Set-Location backend; ./mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
